$comment: Synthetic interview answers for the safety-escalation branch (PRD §7, §8). Written for the demo and the tests so that nobody has to type a real crisis into the box: none of these is a real person's words, and every detail is fictional. The web client's 'Try a sample answer' picker fills the interview box with `text`; tests/safety/escalation-fixtures.test.ts pins `expect` against the decision flow, so change a text and its expectation together. Keep ids stable.

answers.title: Forced to sign, passport held
answers.text: HR kept my original passport when I joined and says I will get it back only after the bond period. Yesterday they made me sign a new bond and I was not allowed to leave the office until I signed.

answers.title: A threat of violence
answers.text: The owner's brother came to the flat last night with two men and said they will beat me if I am not out by Sunday. I have the agreement here.

answers.title: Violence at home
answers.text: My husband hits me when I ask about the flat papers. The agreement is in his name and I want to know what it says about me.

answers.title: A child at risk
answers.text: The agent says the deposit is gone, but that is not the main thing: the owner's son follows my daughter and she is not safe in that building.

answers.title: Not wanting to live
answers.text: The recovery calls do not stop and I don't want to live anymore. I uploaded the notice but I cannot think straight.

answers.title: A dispute, nobody in danger
answers.text: The landlord is threatening to go to court over the deposit and says he will keep the whole amount because I left before the lock-in ended.
